name: substrio
description: Connects Codex to Substrio. Your owner signs in once, and every Substrio tool is ready.

interface.shortDescription: Build, run, and ship apps on Substrio.
interface.longDescription: Substrio is an app platform. An account holds apps, and each app comes with a host, data, functions, files, users, and a site. This plugin connects Codex to Substrio's tools. Your owner signs in once, and Codex can build, test, and ship their apps.
interface.defaultPrompt: Build me an app on Substrio.
